whisperHintSuffix: Сохраняй и корректно распознавай технические термины: console.log, function, const, import, export, git push, npm install, JSON, API, TypeScript, React, useState, useEffect. Если слышишь 'слеш', 'точка', 'дефис', 'нижнее подчеркивание', корректно восстанавливай технический фрагмент.
rules: The speaker usually dictates development tasks to a person or coding agent, not source code. Keep instructions as instructions, not implementations.
Preserve all requirements, negations, numbers, dependencies and action order; keep branch, repository, board-column and identifier names exact.
Normalize unambiguous technical terms (Git, API, MCP, PIM, React, TypeScript, DeepSeek, frontend, backend). Do not guess unknown project-specific names.
Convert code or spoken symbols only when their exact syntax is explicitly dictated. Never invent a function call, arguments, identifier casing or a path.
Remove accidental disfluencies conservatively. Do not shorten, summarize or add formatting.
